classification.difficultyReason: Combine the given angles across the two right triangles to find the outer triangle's 55° angle, then express AB using its hypotenuse and the sine ratio.

spec.description: A lies above B; B, C and D are collinear in that order. AD is labelled x. The narrow angle CAD has a leader label.
spec.mathematics: AB is perpendicular to BD; angle BCA is 70 degrees and angle CAD is 15 degrees.

answer.short:
$AB=x\sin55^\circ$.

Find $\angle ADB=55^\circ$, then use the sine ratio in $\triangle ABD$.
answer.worked:
$\begin{align*}\angle BAC&=180^\circ-90^\circ-70^\circ\\\angle BAC&=20^\circ\\\angle BAD&=20^\circ+15^\circ\\\angle BAD&=35^\circ\\\angle ADB&=180^\circ-90^\circ-35^\circ\\\angle ADB&=55^\circ\end{align*}$
In right-angled $\triangle ABD$,
$\begin{align*}\sin55^\circ&=\frac{AB}{x}\\AB&=x\sin55^\circ.\end{align*}$
